purpose: Estimate and test a DGraph batch size that fits one HCCS-90 RTX 4090 without presenting it as the historical step-30 reproduction.

estimate.observed_failure: batch_size=65536 failed before the first optimizer update with 22.44 GiB allocated, 22.71 GiB reserved, 338.56-356.56 MiB free, and a failed 448 MiB allocation
estimate.fallback_policy: Run only if batch_size=49152 terminates with CUDA OOM before a complete step-0 AUC/AP record.
estimate.rationale: Batch-scaled Transformer, reconstruction, and autograd tensors dominate the observed peak; reducing the batch by 25 percent should recover several GiB while retaining a larger batch than an immediate halving. Full-graph tensors create a fixed memory floor, so this is an empirical estimate, not a guarantee.

protocol.success_condition: One offline W&B history record containing _step=0, AUC, and AP, followed by a task-owned stop and successful local record replay.
